invariants.name: No Checkable Claims Abstention
invariants.description: Non-checkable statements (opinion, rhetorical questions) must strictly abstain with score 0.0.

invariants.name: No Usable Evidence Abstention
invariants.description: Factual claims with empty or ungrounded evidence must strictly abstain with score 0.0.

invariants.name: Synthetic Fixture Quarantine in Production
invariants.description: Synthetic demo fixtures must be rejected when allow_synthetic_evidence=False, forcing abstention.

invariants.name: Stylometric Red Flags Non-Conviction Gate
invariants.description: Red flags reflect writing style only and cannot independently trigger fake/misleading verdicts.

invariants.name: Classical ML Inability to Bypass Evidence Gate
invariants.description: Even 98% ML confidence cannot produce an ungrounded verdict when factual evidence is absent.

invariants.name: LLM Reasoner Failure Graceful Fallback
invariants.description: If evidence exists but the LLM reasoner is unavailable/timed out, the system must safely abstain.

invariants.name: LLM Unverifiable Assessment Honor Guard
invariants.description: When the LLM concludes unverifiable, fusion must strictly abstain with score 0.0.

invariants.name: Evidence Precedence Over Contrary ML (Reliable)
invariants.description: Verified supporting evidence overrides contrary statistical ML predictions.

invariants.name: Evidence Precedence Over Contrary ML (Fake)
invariants.description: Verified contradicting evidence overrides contrary statistical ML predictions.

invariants.name: Strict Abstention Score Heuristic Equivalence
invariants.description: System abstention strictly implies support_score == 0.0 with zero exceptions.
